comments.body: Which version are you using? Try updating to latest

Using 2d3c7e7-2018.04.22

Working in mmol/L - when I put a calibration into xdrip it shows it in the queue for the transmitter, as the mg/DL equivalent, and then I get a notification saying "Calibration rejected: unknown code 12". It then halts the session with an "Insufficient calibration: G5 Sensor Stopped" notification.

Calibrating on the receiver feeds over to xdrip within 3 cycles and it restarts again.
@alternateal don't worry about the mg/dl stuff, under the hood it is all mg/dl. Is there any chance your sensor has failed?

update: 
In addition to "Calibration rejected: Sensor stopped",
 I had problems of high noise.
Now I turned off the smartwatch (huawiWatch 2 Which was not for collection) and I was just using the phone - and all working well

@jamorham - no the sensor it working perfectly, and it failed over to xdrip calibration, once the receiver had talked to the transmitter and the transmitter recycled then xdrip picked up the G5Native signal again. 

This happened last night also, but I was too tired to really log the issue.
Anyone having problems related in this issue please make sure to upgrade to May 10th nightly or above and re-test. Should be resolved now.

I have the nightly 05-11 installed yesterday and still have calibration rejected errors all the time with my G5. Using Samsung s8 and native algorithm.

Edit: I disabled Bluetooth for a few minutes and also enabled the 'go on without calibrations' settings. After restarting the sensor it warmed up 2hrs and since then works like a charm, including backfill! Great!
